name: Akai Ito
source:
To arrange the inheritance because of the loss of her mother, [url=/c10490]Hatou Kei[/url] heads for her fathers house in Hemizuka. In the train on the way there, Kei has a mysterious dream of a huge tree and a woman who seems to be lost in sadness. In the land of Hemizuka, Kei learns the secret concealed in her own blood through various meeting with an Oni Slayer, a friend of her late mother, a young girl accompanied by a white fox, and even the mysterious girl from her dreams.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akai_Ito]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世后，为了处理遗产，[url=/c10490]羽藤桂[/url]前往经观塚的父亲旧宅。途中，她在火车上做了一个神秘的梦，梦中有一棵巨树，以及一名仿佛沉浸在悲伤中的女子。来到经观塚后，桂先后遇见一名鬼切者、亡母的友人、白狐相伴的少女，甚至还有梦中的神秘女子。通过这些邂逅，她逐渐得知隐藏在自己血脉中的秘密。

[改编自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akai_Ito]维基百科[/url]]
